items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: I think it was some Irving Berlin thing, but it was real pretty.

ctx.x: Do you remember any favorite tunes that weren't recorded?

Uh, there was one that they used to play with, where they played with Don in the band that was never recorded, but I'm not sure. I think it was all alone on the telephone. I'm trying to piece it together now afterwards, uh, but it had a theme in it, uh, there's no place like home theme, and, and, and somewhere stuck in the middle of the tune. And, uh, I think it was some Irving Berlin thing, but it was real pretty. They, they really did it well. And, uh, outside of that, and Honeysuckle, and, uh, Mylenberg Joyce,…
Mylenberg, but not Honeysuckle, I don't know.
